record_type_quote:
In this study we set out to replicate five experiments showing
SBB correlations.

targets.authors: Forstmann, B. U., Anwander, A., Schäfer, A., Neumann, J., Brown, S., Wagenmakers, E.-J., et al.
targets.title: Cortico-striatal connections predict control over speed and accuracy in perceptual decision making.
targets.outcome_quote:
The five studies we attempted to replicate contained a total of 17 SBB correlations. The results from our
confirmatory analyses show that we were unable to successfully replicate any of these 17 correlations.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall verdict over all five attempted studies and all 17 effects takes priority over individual exploratory comparisons.
